Admissions enquiries
If you have an admissions related query please email Applications and Admissions at
admission@auckland.ac.nz
.
Search for an agent
The University of Auckland has a number of overseas representatives who can help you to plan your studies at the University of Auckland, apply for a student visa and more.
Search for an agent
near you.
Notice to Prospective Education Agents
We deeply value and appreciate the important role that education agents play in supporting our international students throughout their study journey. Your dedication and efforts are integral to the success and well-being of our students.
At this time, we are not accepting applications for new agent partnerships. We thank you for your understanding and continued support.
